verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official, open-source Ramp CLI (github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli). It installs via curl or brew, uses OAuth plus a headless agent login, offers an --agent JSON output mode and --no-input for CI, and covers 12 resources. Ramp's own docs name the CLI as the channel for coding agents and scripted workflows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of CLI usage.
